title: Whole Life Insurance Contract Clause: Application of the Termination Dividend at a Reduced Paid-Up Election
content:
The termination dividend at a reduced paid-up election on an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy is applied under the dividend option of the most recent declared dividend on the policy ledger.

**Clause.**

(a) Under the **accumulate** option, it is added to the net cash value and buys reduced paid-up insurance with it.

(b) Under the **paid-up additions** option, it buys paid-up additions of its own at the net single premium per 1,000 of paid-up insurance; their face, to the cent (the termination dividend divided by that net single premium, times 1,000, rounded half up to the cent), is added to the reduced face outside its rounding to the whole dollar.

(c) Under **any other option** (reduce premium, cash or none), it is paid to the owner in cash and does not enter the net cash value.

**Which option governs.** The option recorded on the latest dividend declaration entry on the policy's activity history, whatever option the owner has requested since.

**Illustration (hypothetical termination dividend 900.00, net single premium 520.40 per 1,000, net cash value otherwise 29968.73).**

| Option of the latest declaration | Net cash value | Reduced face |
|---|---|---|
| Accumulate | 30868.73 | 30868.73 divided by 520.40, times 1,000, rounded to the dollar: 59317 |
| Paid-up additions | 29968.73 | 57588 plus additions of 1729.44: 59317.44 |
| Cash | 29968.73 | 57588; the 900.00 is paid to the owner |
